planned_variants.variant: similarity=true with a fingerprinted permuted-order dataset view

notes: This is a simulator-oracle-information sensitivity, not a fair-information main comparison: the synthetic group order is generated from the simulator trajectory and is unavailable to SPATHI.
Results are interpreted as an information-advantaged upper-bound sensitivity and never enter the primary ranking.
scMTNI indep=true is not a valid multigroup baseline with the current wrapper.
Simulator lineage_tree gain/loss rates are derived from true group GRNs; native files are leaky and forbidden for an order-only comparison.
scMTNI stays blocked until a justified neutral lineage-rate dataset is derived with a new fingerprint.
The sole executable SimiC route consumes observed ordered column phenotypes with every scientific parameter at its upstream default.
The non-default similarity=false variant is intentionally not executed.

The permuted-order negative control is blocked: order is the column_phenotypes.tsv dataset extra, so a permutation must be represented as a content-addressed derived dataset view with its own fingerprint; current evaluation and joint-integration contracts require one unchanged fingerprint per dataset comparison.
